title: Black Ribbed Zip Crop & White Jeans
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight light brown hair blowing slightly across her face stands against a white backdrop. She wears a fitted black ribbed knit cropped zip cardigan with a crew neck and a small embroidered mark. A black belt sits over wide white denim trousers. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, white, and warm skin tones. Clean and sleek, in the style of a minimal streetwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The ribbed zip crop and white denim are the key contrast.
- Keep the windblown hair for movement against the white backdrop.
